The golf sites are niche and affiliate pages that judge golf GPS features. Their main picks cost more than $300 (S70, S50, Venu 4), or they skip sleep and workout tracking. Only Golf GPS Authority answers the exact question, with an older pick and no data. A focused page comparing golf plus fitness watches under $300, with live prices, would stand out.
